fusions.name: Cascade Display
fusions.desc: A ring of water bursts outward and deals 26 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. If it hits, you and your allies deal 20% more damage for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Mangle
fusions.desc: Grips the target and wrings it out: it deals 8 damage, leaves it 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds, and has a 40% chance to leave it [Enervated] for 6 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Leaf Sponge
fusions.desc: Restores 16 health to you, with a 10% chance to land as a critical heal. The healing rises 8% for every tenth of your health already gone, up to 40%.

fusions.name: Flood Temper
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once: you deal 6% more damage per stack (30% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
